note: Capabilities are the things an agent or a human can DO. A task group does not 'finish' a thing -- it moves capabilities from BLOCKED to AVAILABLE, and the newly available set is how you know the task worked. Validation therefore has three independent legs: (1) did it compile or save, (2) do our own checks agree, (3) can we now exercise something that previously errored. Leg 3 is the one that catches a green build that produced nothing.

groups.label: The in-game probe and its telemetry
Creation Kit and xEdit as tools

capabilities.label: Creation Kit is installed and build-matched to the game
capabilities.exercise: tools\pipmon.ps1 editor preflight
capabilities.evidence: creationKit == game version, buildsMatch true

capabilities.label: The CK render window is usable (no crash on viewport)
capabilities.exercise: open the render viewport on a SMALL interior cell
capabilities.evidence: log.txt gains fresh Umbra/tome lines, and no new CreationKit crash dump appears

capabilities.label: Editor render stability (CKPE, or the in-house replacement)
capabilities.exercise: install CKPE via Vortex, or ship an in-house equivalent
capabilities.evidence: three render sessions with zero new CreationKit dumps

capabilities.label: xEdit runs headlessly for plugin inventory
capabilities.exercise: tools\pipmon.ps1 validate
capabilities.evidence: runs/watch/xedit-latest.json status == PASS with a records_detail array

capabilities.label: xEdit's first-run notice has been dismissed once
capabilities.exercise: launch xFOEdit64.exe once and click through the notice
capabilities.evidence: a headless run completes instead of timing out

capabilities.label: vprobe loads into a live game with no F4SE present
capabilities.exercise: tools\testenv.ps1 run
capabilities.evidence: runs/<ts>/run.json reachedReady=true and the trace shows 'Runtime ready: 18/18 probes resolved'

capabilities.label: A vtable slot is hooked so the VM can resolve our natives
capabilities.exercise: (not built -- needs a BSScript declaration in method order)
capabilities.evidence: s0Version != 0 in the save's script properties

capabilities.label: Compile a .psc to a verified .pex
capabilities.exercise: tools\pipmon.ps1 build
capabilities.evidence: PipMon.pex and PipMonTestFacility.pex exist with PEX magic DE C0 57 FA

capabilities.label: Our plugin is a valid, active file in the load order
capabilities.exercise: tools\pipmon.ps1 link status
capabilities.evidence: PipMonTestFacility.esp is enabled AND last

capabilities.label: An interior cell of our own exists and can be entered
capabilities.exercise: CK: World > Worldspaces > DefaultWorld > create a new CELL, EditorID PipMonFacilityCell
capabilities.evidence: xEdit inventory shows a CELL named PipMonFacilityCell; render shows it lit

capabilities.label: Workbench, power armour station and terminal are placed in that cell
capabilities.exercise: drag three vanilla objects into the cell viewport
capabilities.evidence: render shows three objects; xEdit shows REFR entries in the cell

capabilities.label: Confirm the cell renders as authored (not just that bytes grew)
capabilities.exercise: open the CK render window on the cell; do NOT run navmesh or batch compute
capabilities.evidence: log.txt Umbra lines newer than the save, zero new crash dumps

capabilities.label: A compiled script can be attached to a placed object
capabilities.exercise: CK: Scripts > Import the .pex, then object > Properties > Script
capabilities.evidence: xEdit inventory shows a VMAD script entry on the terminal REFR

capabilities.label: Script properties can be filled by dragging objects, with no hardcoded IDs
capabilities.exercise: CK: terminal properties, drag refs into TerminalRef/WorkbenchRef/PowerArmorStationRef/SpawnHub
capabilities.evidence: xEdit inventory shows property values referencing the placed REFRs

capabilities.label: Enter the authored cell in the playable build and see it
capabilities.exercise: in-game console: coc PipMonFacilityCell
capabilities.evidence: Papyrus.0.log activity on cell load; the player sees the fixtures

capabilities.label: A compiled script actually calls our natives and gets an answer (S0)
capabilities.exercise: the script's one-shot timer fires RunNativeProbe ~2s after the cell loads
capabilities.evidence: s0Passed true / s0Version != 0 in the save, plus a session-log entry

capabilities.label: Give the test character its kit (weapon, armour frame, armour, test item, bench parts)
capabilities.exercise: call SetupTestCharacter() from the surface or the terminal
capabilities.evidence: the bitfield comes back non-zero: 1 weapon, 2 frame, 4 armour, 8 item, 16 parts, 32 already-set

capabilities.label: Enter power armour at the station
capabilities.exercise: call EnterPowerArmor()
capabilities.evidence: returns false if no frame is carried -- that refusal IS the correct behaviour

capabilities.label: Place a roster of NPCs/robots/synths and hand them to the game's own AI
capabilities.exercise: call PopulateRoster() once 15 ActorBase properties are assigned
capabilities.evidence: returns 15; each actor has EvaluatePackage(true) + EnableAI(true), so they move because the game moves them

capabilities.label: Remove ONLY the actors the script placed
capabilities.exercise: call ClearRoster()
capabilities.evidence: returns 0 after the call and the placed* properties are none again; player-placed actors untouched

capabilities.label: An NPC vendor carrying stock, for merchant-path testing
capabilities.exercise: CK-side: vendor script + container on MerchantRef, or FCOM's caravan merchants
capabilities.evidence: the merchant opens a barter menu with non-empty stock

capabilities.label: Workshop/settlement mode in the bunker
capabilities.exercise: wire the settlement trigger + LocType keywords; or hold it out entirely
capabilities.evidence: the workbench accepts a build; NOTE SimSettlements 2 is deliberately excluded so this conflict is resolved by omission

capabilities.label: Navmesh for a cell
capabilities.exercise: generate navmesh IN THIS CELL ONLY
capabilities.evidence: a navmesh record for that cell; an interior cell does not need the 120-cell wilderness pass
